label: MongoDB
notes: Every change is a new file from `npx migrate-mongo create <name>` with `up` and `down`; an applied migration is never edited.
Collection schema validation (`$jsonSchema` validators) is the shape guard and is versioned in the migration that changes the shape.
Indexes are created in migrations, never from the console.
Authorization uses database roles per environment; tenant filtering lives in the application data layer and is tested.
Destructive updates (`$unset`, `$rename`, mass deletes) need owner approval and a `mongodump` first.
